sessions.title: July 14 - Live Trading
sessions.summary: Morning New York session on a high-impact news (CPI/PPI week) day; he signs off 'We will be back again for Asia. Have a great start to your day.' Much of the screen time is a Brent crude (XBRUSD, Fusion Markets CFD) chart wedged between a DSD high, a 4h FVG and previous day's high, where the first 30-second FVG never got tapped and remaining setups were 1:1.12 risk-to-reward; US500 printed a Spotlight bullish confirmation and a news-candle double break (news at 5:30 on his Pacific-set clock = 8:30 ET) that he declared void; US30 had a double break. Zero trades taken; the main unnamed chart (single M on the 5m, DSD high, 4h FVG) is not explicitly identified as NAS so it is labelled 'unknown'. Note: calendar check - he says 'this week' is CPI/PPI week and the July 16 part 2 transcript says Tuesday was CPI; year 2026 is assumed per instructions.

sessions.title: July 16 - Live Trading (part 1)
sessions.summary: Evening (Asia) session with a Trump speech scheduled at 6 p.m. on his Pacific-set clock, 'smack dab in the middle of our trading session in the evening'; bearish confirmations and double breaks on all three indices, so it was 'a sell or nothing'. Market ran away without a 5m pullback; only US30 formed a 5m bearish FVG and he dropped to the 1m to wait for it. No trades taken - 'Sorry, we didn't catch anything there, guys.' Any setup during the speech would have been demo-only. File is labelled July 16 but as an evening session preceding the July 16 NY session (part 2) it most likely ran on the evening of July 15 ET.

events.setup: Bearish confirmation across the board, market running away - waiting for a pullback / proper FVG foothold
reasons: When you see the market just constantly dropping. Remember that's just a runaway
unless there's an actual foothold entry, a proper fair value gap, we're not interested
They've already taken out the lows from earlier today
events.quote: It's either going to run away from us and we can't get in, or it's creating breadcrumbs for the people who are getting FOMO and they want to jump in because the market's dropping, and then they'll push it back up. Either way, unless there's an actual foothold entry, a proper fair value gap, we're not interested.

events.setup: Trump speaking at 6 p.m. (his Pacific-set clock, ~9 PM ET) in the middle of the evening session - any setup during the speech goes in a demo account; 'we're going to wait the next 11 minutes'
reasons: there's really no way to maneuver or trade during that time when he's talking
any trade set up that I take in the next, however long he's talking is going to have to be in a demo account to protect myself
You could just see a massive displacement candle just out of the blue because of one thing he says
this is rare. To see a speech smack dab in the middle of our trading session in the evening
events.result_detail: Clock caveat: '6 p.m.' is read from his calendar; his chart time is set to Pacific (stated July 14), so 21:00 ET is inferred.
events.quote: Did we have something happening at 6 p.m.? So Trump speaking at 6 p.m. I'm surprised that's not red folder. ... So any trade set up that I take in the next, however long he's talking is going to have to be in a demo account to protect myself.

events.setup: FVG invalidation: a closure on the same timeframe beyond the high/low of the leg containing the FVG, with no immediate rebalance (one extra candle grace), invalidates it
reasons: you just have to run the high and or the low of the leg that contains that fair value gap
if I close above here on the five minute and I don't get an immediate rebalance back into the range... sometimes we'd give it one more candle
if it's a one minute fair value gap, then you need a one minute closure above that line
events.quote: So every single fair value gap, in order to get invalidated, you just have to run the high and or the low of the leg that contains that fair value gap. ... So if it's a one minute fair value gap, then you need a one minute closure above that line. If it's a 30 second, I need a 30 second candle to close above that line or below that line.

events.setup: NAS 5m leg high taken out - watching whether the candle closes above (invalidation) or it's a stop hunt with an immediate rebuff creating a 5m bearish FVG
reasons: We just took out that high. I want to see if this closes now. If this was just a stop hunt
we're getting an immediate rebuff
events.quote: So we just took out that high. Okay. We just took out that high. I want to see if this closes now. If this was just a stop hunt. ... So we're getting an immediate rebuff. So let's see if this was just a stop hunt. And now we get a five minute bearish fair value gap.

events.setup: Leg definition: going down, a new leg starts on the first candle that takes out the previous candle's high; going up, on the first candle that takes out the previous candle's low
reasons: every single leg that's dropping is taking out the previous leg's low
as soon as a candle takes out the previous candle's high, that starts a new leg
events.quote: So remember if we're going down, then as soon as a candle takes out the previous candle's high, that starts a new leg. If we're going up, if the current candle takes out the previous candle's low, that starts a new leg up.

events.setup: Entry/break definition: a 30-second entry must close above the line, not at it; a break or closure must be higher by at least one tick - same price is not a break
reasons: I need to see it close above that line
Just getting to the same exact point does not constitute as a break
Even if it's one pip higher, that constitutes as a closure
events.quote: So I want to see this candle's wick show up higher, even if it's one tick. Higher than the previous one. It can't be the same. That does not constitute as a break. Same thing with a closure. Even if it's one pip higher, that constitutes as a closure.

reasons: There is no one minute. We're only looking at it on the five minute

that was just a reference point where I wanted it to retrace back to. That was not my five minute fair value gap
events.quote: There is no one minute. We're only looking at it on the five minute. Right? There's your five minute double break. Pull back. I need to see a five minute fair value gap. ... sessions.title: July 16 - Live Trading (part 2)

Price was already outside the range inside a 4h FVG; NAS had a bearish double break and was the weaker pair (sell only), while he wanted a long on US30 (preferred) or US500 at reduced lot. US30 gave an immediate rebalance off a second 5m FVG (his one compromise) but took off without a 1m/30s entry; US500 was tapped on the 5m and 1m but never gave the 30-second, then printed a big drop and a possible 5m bearish reversal FVG. Zero trades taken; late setups were downgraded to demo.
